title: What happened to Duda Alves? Brazilian TikToker dies at 22 after documenting painful surgery recovery
summary_full: Tragedy strikes the Brazilian TikTok community as creator Duda Alves dies at just twenty-two years old. Her family shared the heartbreaking news two days after her passing, prompting police to launch an investigation into the circumstances surrounding her death. Recently, Alves documented her difficult healing journey post-surgery, leaving everyone puzzled about the cause of her untimely demise.
